narrative.northStar: A beautifully engineered CLI that happens to be a website — every joke kept, every pixel disciplined.
narrative.overview: Mode A refresh: identity pinned (palette, type, voice, motifs), execution modernized (poster display type, stepped surfaces, modular scale, zine band cadence, AA-everywhere).
keyCharacteristics: terminal-native chrome as the primary component language
accent trio deployed like syntax highlighting
color-blocked full-bleed bands as section rhythm
modular 1.25 type scale with precision display tracking
man-page system treated as a first-class design surface
rules: Every section must survive: 'would this render in a terminal?'
One primary CTA verb: Get SLICC; one demo verb: See it work
No gradients, shadows, photography, or off-palette color
Black type on green/orange bands; paper type on crimson
Mono output floor #8f8f8f; dimmer only for # comments
dos: Frame videos in traffic-light terminal chrome
